title: get_root_api_running_status
description: Verify that a GET request to the root endpoint '/' returns a 200 status code with a message confirming the API is running, without requiring authentication.

title: get_health_endpoint_status
description: Verify that a GET request to '/health' returns a 200 status code with the current service status and health state, without requiring authentication.

title: post_user_registration_with_valid_data
description: Test user registration by sending a POST request to '/api/v1/auth/register' with a valid email and password, expecting a 201 response with access_token, token_type, and user_hash.

title: post_user_login_with_valid_credentials
description: Test user login by sending a POST request to '/api/v1/auth/login' with valid credentials, expecting a 200 response with access_token, token_type, and user_hash.

title: post_chat_message_with_valid_jwt_and_first_message
description: Test sending a chat message with a valid JWT, session_id, messages array, and is_first_message=true to '/api/v1/chat/message', expecting a 200 response with response text, ml_signals, escalate and crisis flags, and session_id.

title: post_ml_emotion_classification_with_valid_jwt
description: Test emotion classification by sending a POST request to '/api/v1/ml/emotion' with text and a valid JWT, expecting a 200 response with dominant_emotion and probability scores.

title: get_session_history_list_with_valid_jwt
description: Test retrieval of recent session metadata by sending a GET request to '/api/v1/history/sessions' with a valid JWT, expecting a 200 response with an array of session metadata.

title: post_report_generation_with_valid_jwt_and_complete_data
description: Test report generation by sending a POST request to '/api/v1/report/generate' with valid JWT and complete session data including session_id, messages array, topic, emotion_arc, and final_severity, expecting a 200 response with session_id and structured report object.
